title: For God's sake, please stand with us: DHCBA President to lawyers appearing before Delhi HC despite strike
description: Delhi High Court Bar Association (DHCBA) president N Hariharan on Tuesday made a fervent appeal to lawyers to refrain from appearing before the court today in protest against the recent proposal to increase the pecuniary jurisdiction of district courts in Delhi.The DHCBA had announced suspension of work to oppose the Delhi High Court's administrative decision to recommend the enhancement of the pecuniary jurisdiction of district courts in the national capital from ₹2 crore to ₹10 crore.Neverthel
